He asked me where had I lived in.
He asked me where I lived in.
He asked me where I had lived in.

q: Sumon said, “I wish I were a child”. (Indirect)
o: Sumon wished he were a child.
Sumon said that he wished he had been a child.
Sumon exclaimed with wish if he had been a child.
Sumon wished if he had been a child.
e:
Sumon wished he were a child বাক্যটি শুদ্ধ, কারণ wish-এর বাক্যে past subjunctive were থাকলে narration-এ তা অপরিবর্তিত থাকে, আর reporting verb said বদলে wished হয়।

  • Wish-এর পরে বাস্তবের বিপরীত কল্পনায় সব person-এর সাথে were বসে, যেমন: I wish I were a bird।
  • Wish প্রকাশক বাক্যে said বদলে wished বা expressed a wish ব্যবহার হয়।
  • Wish-এর পরে that থাকলেও চলে, না থাকলেও চলে।
  • একই Past subjunctive ব্যবহার হয় If-clause-এও, যেমন: If I were you, I would go।

q: The president said, "May our country prosper." (Change into indirect speech)
o: The president told that their country should prosper.
The president wished that their country might prosper.
The president told that their country might prosper.
The president wished that their country should prosper.

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, "Alas! I am ruined."
o: He said sorrowfully that he is ruined.
He exclaimed sorrowfully that he was ruined.
He exclaimed that I was ruined.
He asked sorrowfully if he was ruined.
e:
A sentence beginning with 'Alas!' is an exclamatory sentence expressing sorrow. In indirect speech we replace 'said' with 'exclaimed with sorrow' (or 'exclaimed sorrowfully'), drop the interjection and use 'that'. The tense also changes from 'am' to 'was'.
মনে রাখুন:
Alas! → exclaimed sorrowfully
Hurrah! → exclaimed with joy
What a...! → exclaimed that it was a very...

q: The indirect speech: He asked me, "Must you leave now?"
o: He asked me if I must have left then.
He asked me if I had to leave then.
He asked me if I must leave then.
He asked me if I had to leave now.
e:
He asked me if I had to leave then বাক্যটি শুদ্ধ, কারণ বাধ্যবাধকতা বোঝানো must অতীত reporting verb-এর পরে had to হয়, আর now হয়ে যায় then।

  • must (বাধ্যবাধকতা) → had to; must (অনুমান/সম্ভাবনা) অনেক সময় অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।
  • Time-নির্দেশক শব্দ বদলায়: now → then, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, yesterday → the previous day।
  • Yes/No প্রশ্নে asked এর সাথে if বসে এবং statement-এর word order হয়।
  • must-এর অতীত রূপ নেই বলে had to ব্যবহার হয়, যেমন: I must go → I had to go।

q: He said to his friends, “Let us play now.”
o: He requested to his friends that they should play then
He proposed to his friends that they would play then
He proposed to his friends that they should play then
He proposed to his friends that we should play then
e: “Let us ...” প্রস্তাব, তাই indirect-এ proposed/suggested + that + they should বসে। Us বক্তা ও বন্ধুদের ধরে, সে কারণে we বদলে they হয়। Now বদলে then বসে। সঠিক রূপ: He proposed to his friends that they should play then। Would বসালে অর্থ বদলে যায়, we রাখা person ভুল, আর requested প্রস্তাবের চেয়ে অনুরোধ বোঝায়।

q: He said, ''Good-bye my friends.'' [change the narration]
o: He asked his friends good-bye.
He says his friends good-bye.
He bade his friends good-bye.
He told his friends good-bye.
e:
He bade his friends good-bye বাক্যটি শুদ্ধ, কারণ Good-bye জাতীয় বিদায়সম্ভাষণ narration-এ bade ক্রিয়া দিয়ে প্রকাশ হয়। Bade হলো bid-এর past form।

  • Bid-এর তিন রূপ: bid, bade/bid, bidden/bid (অর্থ: আদেশ করা বা শুভেচ্ছা জানানো)।
  • Greeting-এর narration: Good morning → wished good morning, Good-bye → bade good-bye, Farewell → bade farewell।
  • Welcome জানানোর বাক্যে bade welcome, যেমন: He bade me welcome।
  • Bid আরেক অর্থে নিলামে দর হাঁকা (to offer a price)।

q: Choose the correct indirect speech of the following direct speech: He said, "We are all sinners."
o: He said that all of them were sinners.
All of us are sinners was told by him.
He said that they were sinners.
He said that we are all sinners.
e: Direct speech-এ চিরন্তন সত্য বা অভ্যাসগত বিষয় থাকলে indirect করার সময় reported speech-এর tense বদলায় না। We are all sinners এমন সার্বজনীন সত্য, তাই reporting verb said থাকে, quotation চিহ্ন সরে গিয়ে that বসে, এবং ভেতরের অংশ অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। ফলে He said that we are all sinners শুদ্ধ।
